page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Expose the minimum configuration surface needed to understand and operate Notification Hub safely.

states.description: Placeholder rows hold the place while a screen's first read is in flight, and are announced as loading.
A screen with nothing yet (no devices, no quiet hours, no escalation channels, no event sources) says so in a sentence and offers the one next step.
A save that landed for some days or a channel and not others names exactly what did not save and keeps the draft; the rest stays saved.
A failed read names the cause with a retry, or shows the sign-in card when the owner session is missing; it never shows an error as an empty list.
Rows from an earlier read stay on screen with a note while a refresh fails, so the screen does not claim they are current.
